subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Vantage — final recommendation
body:
Team,

The human confirmation batch came back Thursday, so locking decisions for the Jul 27 close:

1) Recommendation to serving: switch photographic traffic to jpegli — raters confirmed the metric story, and 12–14% at matched quality is real money at our volume. Zeke, the handoff doc is in the Vantage drive folder.
2) Text-heavy and UI-screenshot traffic stays on MozJPEG for now. Raters penalized the text ringing harder than any metric did, which validates Yusuf's caution; a tuned jpegli config for that slice is the natural Q4 follow-up.
3) Kofi's licensing review cleared with no redistribution concerns for our serving use.
4) The Vantage eval harness and the routing-by-content-type criteria transfer to Zeke's team as maintained artifacts.

That's a clean, defensible split recommendation. Thanks all — especially for insisting on the confirmation batch.

Lucia
